Session date: 6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022
[D18:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no talk! I've been busy with writing projects and really going all out with it. It's been the best thing ever - a mix of highs and lows - and my journal's pretty much my rock. Writing's such a huge part of me now.
[D18:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a bunch of stickers on it
[D18:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! Great to hear it! It's amazing how much a certain activity can become a part of our lives. Keep it up, you're inspiring! Is writing your way to solace and creativity?
[D18:3] Joanna: Yeah, definitely. Writing has become like an escape and a way to express my feelings. It gives me a chance to put all my thoughts and feelings down and make something good out of it. Words just have a magical way of healing.
[D18:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a handwritten letter from a man who is holding a piece of paper
[D18:4] Nate: That's really cool, I like it! It's incredible how words can turn something sad into something special. I'm glad it worked for you. Anything cool happening recently?
[D18:5] Joanna: Yep. Last week, someone wrote me a letter after reading an online blog post I made about a hard moment in my life. Their words touched me; they said my story had brought them comfort. It was awesome to realize my words had that kind of power. It reminded me why I love writing.
[D18:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a note written to a person on a piece of paper
[D18:6] Nate: Nice work, Joanna! That must feel sureal. Keep it up - you're changing lives!
[D18:7] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Really appreciate your kind words. It's knowing that my writing can make a difference that keeps me going, even on tough days. So glad to have this outlet to share my stories and hopefully have an impact. How about you? Anything new since we last talked?
[D18:8] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your words mean a lot. Since we last spoke, I started teaching people how to make this. Sharing my love for dairy-free desserts has been fun and rewarding.
[D18:8] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dessert with whipped cream and chocolate sauce
[D18:9] Joanna: Yum, Nate! I love it when you make coconut milk icecream, it's so good!
[D18:10] Nate: I've been really into making this lately - it's creamy, rich, dairy-free and a new recipe! Wanna try it? I can share the recipe with you if you'd like!
[D18:11] Joanna: I'd love to try it! Thanks for sharing your love for dairy-free desserts. I really appreciate it!
[D18:12] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Always happy to share them with you. Sending you the recipe now!
[D18:13] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Can't wait to surprise my family with something delicious!
[D18:14] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Wish them luck! Let me know how it goes. Have a blast baking!
[D18:15] Joanna: Thanks, Nate. I'll keep you posted. Have a great day.
[D18:16] Nate: You too!

[D19:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a fish tank with a fish inside of it

[D19:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dessert in a glass on a counter

[D19:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two desserts with spoons and a bar of chocolate

[D19:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bookcase filled with books and a toy car

Session date: 2:12 pm on 5 June, 2022
[D15:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!
[D15:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a spider - man poster hanging on a wall

Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?

[D15:7] Joanna: My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.
[D15:8] Nate: Wow Joanna, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?
[D15:9] Joanna: Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.
[D15:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a picture frame with a picture of a family
[D15:10] Nate: That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?
[D15:11] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.
[D15:12] Nate: That's great, Joanna. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.
[D15:13] Joanna: Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.
[D15:14] Nate: I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!
[D15:15] Joanna: I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.
[D15:16] Nate: Of course! Well see you later Joanna!
[D15:17] Joanna: Bye Nate!
Session date: 10:55 am on 24 June, 2022
[D16:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!
[D16:2] Nate: That's really cool Joanna! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.
[D16:3] Joanna: Nice! Did your friends like the controller accessories?

[D16:6] Nate: Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!
[D16:7] Joanna: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!
[D16:8] Nate: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!
[D16:8] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of people sitting on a bench
[D16:9] Joanna: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!
[D16:10] Nate: Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?
[D16:11] Joanna: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!
[D16:12] Nate: Nice one, Joanna! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!
[D16:13] Joanna: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

Session date: 2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a television screen showing a trophy and a trophy
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?

[D17:4] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a book shelf filled with lots of books
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?

[D17:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with writing on it and a pen

Session date: 10:58 am on 9 October, 2022
[D23:18] Joanna: I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.
[D23:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a framed movie poster with a signed picture
[D23:19] Nate: Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?
[D23:20] Joanna: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?
[D23:21] Nate: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.
[D23:22] Joanna: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!
[D23:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a tv and candles

[D23:24] Joanna: You should! It's one thing to watch a movie in a theater, but on a nice comfy couch with a good blanket, I feel so at peace!

[D23:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a poster of a man and a woman sitting on a bench
[D23:27] Nate: Sounds like you really got into making your living room! Thanks, I'll try that out for myself!
[D23:28] Joanna: No problem! I get super invested in random little things like that, but I think its all worth it when I end up with random little things that make life so much nicer.
[D23:29] Nate: Thanks for the tip! See you later!
[D23:30] Joanna: See ya Nate!
Session date: 2:01 pm on 21 October, 2022
[D24:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, what's been up? Haven't seen you since we last talked.
[D24:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! I have been revising and perfecting the recipe I made for my family and it turned out really tasty. What's been happening with you?
[D24:3] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.
[D24:4] Joanna: Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.
[D24:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cat laying on the floor in a room
[D24:5] Nate: Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?
[D24:6] Joanna: I used to have a dog back in Michigan with that name, but then I got allergic and we had to get rid of her. The name helps me remember her back when I used to be able to hold and squeeze animal without an allergic reaction!
[D24:7] Nate: That's so touching! Glad the stuffed animal means so much!
[D24:8] Joanna: Tilly helps me stay focused and brings me so much joy. It's amazing how even stuffed animals can do that!
[D24:9] Nate: It really is, I'm not sure I'll ever understand why watching my turtles slowly walk around makes me so happy. But I'm very glad it does.
[D24:10] Joanna: Same here! So have you been up to anything recenly?
[D24:11] Nate: Yeah, I've just been practicing for my next video game tournemant. How about you?
[D24:12] Joanna: Well, I had a bit of a setback recently - another rejection from a production company.
[D24:13] Nate: Bummer, Joanna. Is this the one you sent to a film contest? Rejections suck, but don't forget they don't define you. Keep at it and you'll find the perfect opportunity.
[D24:14] Joanna: Yeah.. Thanks, Nate. It's hard, but I won't let it slow me down. I'm gonna keep grinding and moving ahead.
[D24:15] Nate: That's what I like to hear! I really respect you for that and being able to bounce back whenever something sad happens!
[D24:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and believing in myself.
[D24:17] Nate: You got this, and don't ever forget that you have people cheering you on from the sidelines wherever you go.
[D24:18] Joanna: Thanks! I'll see you around!
[D24:19] Nate: No problem! Catch you later!
Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, what's been up since we last chatted? How's it going?
[D25:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!
[D25:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a box of cards with a quote on it
[D25:3] Nate: Congrats Joanna! How was it to finally see it on the big screen?

[shares a photo holding a videogame controller]
[D25:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a box with a controller inside of it
[D25:4] Joanna: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!
[D25:5] Nate: That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?
[D25:6] Joanna: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.
[D25:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing book with a bunch of drawings on it
[D25:7] Nate: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?
[D25:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.
[D25:9] Nate: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?
[D25:10] Joanna: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
[D25:11] Nate: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
[D25:12] Joanna: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!
[D25:13] Nate: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!
[D25:14] Joanna: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?
[D25:15] Nate: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.
[D25:15] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two turtles sitting on a log in a pond
[D25:16] Joanna: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?
[D25:17] Nate: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.
[D25:17] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog laying on a rock in a zoo
[D25:18] Joanna: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?
[D25:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a spoon full of ice cream and chocolate sauce

Session date: 11:54 am on 2 May, 2022

[D10:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a book openhemer
